# @three-ws/concierge-mcp

> Ask any website's AI concierge a grounded question, and generate the copy-paste embed code to add a three.ws Concierge (an AI chat widget with a 3D avatar) to a site. concierge_ask fetches a page and answers from its real content; concierge_embed builds the one-tag install; concierge_avatars lists the avatars. No key, no signer, no payment.

@three-ws/concierge-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/concierge-mcp`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/concierge-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/concierge-mcp/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/concierge-mcp/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/concierge-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
